assessment.native_host_brand: deliveryCredentialHosts is a module-private WeakMap keyed by the exact frozen returned native host. Host brand shares only the private issuer owner/storage with its proof records. Reader rejects absent/non-native selected host, storage mismatch, different owner and inactive owner. Structural copies, prototypes and proxies of a real host cannot acquire the brand.
assessment.selected_host_parameter: The generic native helper accepts selectedHost and can read a genuine unpublished issuer's own facts if deliberately selected by trusted native code. That is not worker authorization: generated persistence no longer calls that helper. It imports readCurrentDeliveryCredentialProof from the generated app, whose sole argument is proof and whose body closes over private firstPartyAuthentication plus the actual storage. Supplying extra host arguments or borrowing a hostile this cannot alter that selection. No authored callback, issuer setter, structural principal or caller-provided facts reaches the authority method.
assessment.initialization: Generated app clears and invalidates its old host before configuration work. Successful current-generation native creation alone publishes a host. A discarded stale initialized host is explicitly invalidated and cannot replace a newer success or recover after a newer failed initialization. Pending/absent host fails closed; old host/proof is withdrawn. Overlapping successful and failed generation controls pass independently in the focused tests.
assessment.wait_fence: Authority calls the generated current-issuer closure both before live SQL and after awaited SQL/digest/time work. Actual native metadata digest withdrawal test rejects stale selected proof and permits a freshly prepared proof from the new current host; no post-admission cut was added.
assessment.import_cycle: Generated app uses live imports for both persistence and rootPersistence, rather than sampling a top-level const alias across the new app/persistence cycle. Fresh separate Bun processes independently import app-first and persistence-first on both actual adapters; no TDZ/default-host fallback, forged callback or module rewrite is needed.
assessment.retained_transaction_contract: The correction changes only proof-reader calls in delivery_authority.rs. Exact selected live-row SQL, c/s/m/k PostgreSQL locks, closed metadata comparison, database-time sample after lock waits, active owning transaction and nested savepoint remain intact. Focused both-adapter actual SQL fault, expiry, wrong-role and owning lock/rollback regressions remain passing.
assessment.static_and_public_limits: Finished binding, phase/model, fixture and related storage sources retain their prior hashes. Renderer exact test still asserts JADPO_TARGET_JOB_NOT_IMPLEMENTED. Emitted binding remains runtime_lowering_supported:false, live_authority_established:false and execution_profile:null. No policy permission or public job activation was introduced.
assessment.security_boundary_limit: Native host APIs are trusted integration APIs, not a sandbox against arbitrary privileged JavaScript or module/crypto monkeypatching. Tests use real HMAC, declared storage and generated authority reads; no standalone invented principal or callback is used as worker authority.
